title.zh: 【德国储蓄银行开始逐步上线加密货币交易服务】
title.en: 【德国储蓄银行开始逐步上线加密货币交易服务】

current_state.zh: Germany's savings banks began a phased rollout of crypto trading through their existing apps on Oct. 19, starting with BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, DekaBank custody and a €0.99 per-order fee, with broad coverage targeted by H1 2027.
current_state.en: Germany's savings banks began a phased rollout of crypto trading through their existing apps on Oct. 19, starting with BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, DekaBank custody and a €0.99 per-order fee, with broad coverage targeted by H1 2027.
